text:
maria: heads-up — since the fp8 micro-rollout this morning we've had ~18 OOMs on staging when serving awq-13b variants. looks like kv-cache allocations spike and never compact :grimacing:

kai: ugh. saw one trace that upcast path was triggered on kernel fallback. could be dtype promotion of KV to fp32 for some layers causing workspace blowup :thinking:

devon: attaching a tiny profiler excerpt i pulled from the failing run:
```
GPU0 alloc timeline:
- conv/kernels: steady
- kv_cache: sudden +1.8GB at step 12
- deferred_free latency: 120ms spikes
- malloc failures -> cudnn fallback -> bigger workspace
```
this smells like allocator fragmentation + a kernel that swapped to an FP32 workspace.

infra-bot: deploy #5747 completed to staging (fp8 rollout). baseline perf test passed, canary 3/5 failing under 1.5k concurrent sessions.

samira: quick mitigation ideas:
- force kv cache dtype to fp16 for awq models (avoid per-layer promotion)
- reduce deferred-free window from 200ms -> 50ms so freed buffers can be reused faster
- enable immediate compact-on-surge path when fragmentation ratio > 0.35
will open a PR with flags to test. also want a profiling job with nvtx + allocator stack traces.

lee: agree with samira. also propose a short-term runtime guard: if allocator reports >80% fragmentation AND upcoming workspace request >1GB, reject batch with 429 and log sampling for repro. prevents cascade OOMs.

maria: thanks. for the medium-term: we should root-cause whether kernel selection (scalar heuristics) is choosing an fp32-favoring kernel on certain sequence lengths. if so, either update kernel selector rules or make allocator pre-reserve delta for mixed-precision workspaces.

kai: notes from kernel selector runbook — it currently toggles based on (seq_len, batch_size, model_type). we haven't added kv-dtype into the heuristic. adding kv_dtype as an input would avoid choosing kernels that require larger workspaces when kv_dtype==float32.

devon: here's a tiny repro command i used locally (staging image + synthetic load):
```
./run_infer --model awq-13b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --enable-fp8 --kv-cache=on --seed 41
```
fails ~60% of the time. when i set --kv-dtype=fp16 it becomes stable.

samira: PR #412 coming: config flags below. i'm going to run a 6hr canary with compact-on-surge + deferred-free=50ms + kv-dtype-per-model=prefer-fp16. if stable we'll roll to dedicated canary and then prod.
```
{"allocator.soft_reserve_ratio":"0.12","allocator.deferred_free_ms":"50","allocator.compact_on_surge":"true","kv_dtype_policy":"per_model","kv_dtype_prefer":["fp16","fp32"]}
```

lee: i'll add telemetry dashboards: allocation spikes, fragmentation ratio, avg free latency, number of kernel-fallback events, and OOM count. also add a sampled heapdump on first OOM per container.

maria: plan sounds good. owners: samira (experiment PR + canary), lee (telemetry + guard), devon (repro + profiler traces), kai (kernel selector change). i'll coordinate a quick postmortem if the canary still trips. :eyes:

kai: one more thought — we should document mixed-precision pitfalls in runtime ops guide. small change but saves folks time.

devon: i captured logs and a small heap snapshot, uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/oom-debug/1934567890.tar.gz. ping me if you need access.

maria: thanks team. samira, start the PR and tag me. i'll pause further fp8 rollouts until we validate these mitigations. :thumbsup:
